description: This file contains a test implementation of the ICacheMonitor interface for unit testing. It includes a class that tracks method call counts via counters, which are updated through Interlocked operations, and a counters class with serializable attributes, with some methods to record cache and message statistics.

classes.name: CacheMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of ICacheMonitor that increments counters for each method call.

classes.name: CacheMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class holding counters for monitoring cache-related method calls.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Tracks changes in cache pressure monitor status by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Records reporting of cache size by incrementing its counter.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Records message statistics reporting by incrementing its counter.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Tracks memory allocation events by incrementing the counter.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Tracks memory release events by incrementing the counter.
